notes: Headless Next.js storefront on Vercel over a Shopify backend (f3eba2.myshopify.com). The site displays NO product-count text on listing pages, so every qty is a full enumeration of the listing taken from the server-rendered React Server Component flight payload: props initialProducts.edges (product cards) with pageInfo.hasNextPage=false, i.e. the complete listing. Verified this is the whole grid, not a first page: (a) hasNextPage is false and edge counts are non-uniform (2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 16, 27, and 179 on /collections/all-products) so there is no page cap; (b) the parent/child totals reconcile exactly - Tableware 27 = Dinner Sets 16 + Cup & Saucer 4 + Snack Set 3 + Bowl Set 2 + Tea Set 2, Glassware 9 = Drinking Glass 5 + Beer Mugs 3 + 1 glass mixing bowl, Porcelain 6 = Porcelain Mugs 6; (c) spot-checked against the rendered page via r.jina.ai (Bowl Set renders exactly 2 product cards, the extra cards further down are a 'you may also like' carousel, not collection items). DELIBERATELY NOT USED: products_count from /collections.json on the Shopify backend - it counts products that are not live on the storefront (e.g. Porcelain products_count=67 but only 6 products exist on celloworld.com/collections/porcelain, confirmed by both the storefront payload and /collections/porcelain/products.json=6). Legacy Shopify collections with old-taxonomy titles ('Drinkware' 342, 'Dinnerware' 121, 'Cups and Mugs' 52, 'Opalware' 65, 'Tumblers' 12, 'Jugs and Carafes' 14) are stale and no longer part of the site's category tree - /collections/drinkware now renders only 9 products - so they were not extracted. SCOPE: Cello's range is overwhelmingly excluded material (plastic storage, water bottles/flasks, casseroles, tiffin/lunch boxes, cookware, kitchen appliances, cleaning, Kidzbee kids range), so the qualifying set is the Glassware, Tableware and Porcelain branches of the mega-menu, plus Travel Coffee Mugs and the two glass-material sub-categories Glass Bottles and Glass Jars & Containers. Per the coordinator's ruling that the master spec's 'include ALL glassware, decorative and functional' wins over the assignment note, Glass Bottles (/collections/glass-bottles-1, under Hydration > Bottles) and Glass Jars & Containers (/collections/glass-jars-containers, under Kitchen > Jar and Containers) are included; both counts were derived independently from the RSC payload with pageInfo.hasNextPage=false, and both have live products. Glass Casserole and Glass Lunch Box remain excluded - cookware and food storage by primary purpose regardless of material. The 'Gifting' branch is a gift-guide landing set (bundle collections) and was excluded as marketing navigation. No lighting, wall decor, vases, candles, fragrance or decorative-accessory ranges exist on this site. Nav tree taken from the CMS menu JSON embedded in the homepage flight payload (desktop-header and hamburger-menu, which agree).
